findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "ml" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: embed_texts, rerank_documents, text_similarity, extract_entities, classify_zero_shot, text_summarize, transcribe_podcast_episode, translate_text, check_text_for_prompt_injection, extract_json_with_schema · Private data: embed_texts, embed_multimodal, rerank_documents, text_similarity, transcribe_audio, transcribe_podcast_episode, check_text_for_prompt_injection, extract_json_with_schema, text_to_speech, translate_speech, translate_document · Public sink: text_to_speech.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: embed_texts, rerank_documents, text_similarity, extract_entities, classify_zero_shot, text_summarize, transcribe_podcast_episode, translate_text, check_text_for_prompt_injection, extract_json_with_schema · Private data: embed_texts, embed_multimodal, rerank_documents, text_similarity, transcribe_audio, transcribe_podcast_episode, check_text_for_prompt_injection, extract_json_with_schema, text_to_speech, translate_speech, translate_document · Public sink: text_to_speech

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
